result.edit: The failure shows the output was 1 when expected to be 0 at cycle 8 in mode 1 (odd period). The current code uses div_o>>1 for the odd period threshold, but the specification requires floor(div_o/4)+1. Changing to div_o>>2 matches the specification by using a right shift of 2 bits (equivalent to division by 4) instead of 1. This ensures the output only goes high when clk_cnt is less than or equal to floor(9/4)+1=3 in the odd period mode.
